result.summary: The page is generally well-structured, but horizontally scrolling content is visibly clipped at the right edge, making some labels and cards look cut off rather than intentionally scrollable.

issues.description: The third card in the “Fastest near you” row is cut off by the right screen edge, including the restaurant name (“Trattoria Picco…”), delivery label, and image. This makes the content appear truncated.
issues.suggestion: Provide clearer horizontal-carousel affordance (such as consistent partial-card spacing, a fade/gradient edge, or a visible scroll indicator) and ensure text truncation is deliberate and readable.

issues.description: The category-chip row ends with a partially visible, unlabeled pill at the far right edge, which looks like a rendering or clipping artifact.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the horizontal list padding/scroll position so the next chip is either visibly identifiable or fully offscreen; alternatively add a fade edge to indicate additional categories.

issues.description: The bottom navigation overlays the beginning of the next restaurant card, making the card content underneath appear abruptly cut off.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom content padding so the final visible card area clears the fixed bottom navigation bar.
